audience: coaches, team leaders and players who manage a sports team in Holdsport

useCases.title: Check who has answered for this week's activities
useCases.text: List your teams, then the activities of one team for the week. Check the attendees of an activity to see who has not answered yet.

useCases.title: Read the tasks for a match
useCases.text: Open a match and list its task types, such as snacks or equipment, with the members assigned to each one.

useCases.title: Look up the members of a team
useCases.text: List the members of a team with their roles and contact fields. Open one member to read the full entry.

useCases.title: Read the notes posted for a team
useCases.text: List the notes of a team with their titles, authors and creation times. Ask the assistant for a short summary of the notes.

useCases.title: Mark yourself as attending an activity
useCases.text: Open an activity and check the actions you may take. Then set your status to attending. The team sees the change.
